subject: VaultBridge: request for escrow snapshot + chained-wrapping audit
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@vaultbridge.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@vaultbridge.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: escrow snapshot + chained-wrapping audit for onboarding

Rishi,

Thanks for taking this. We need a short evidence exchange to finish VaultBridge's SIG/SOC2 onboarding. Specifically we require:

- An encrypted escrow snapshot (tar) of tenant key metadata (no plaintext key material unless strictly necessary) for billing tenant VB-9938.
- Signed rotation log slice covering 2028-05-01 -> 2028-06-12 with per-op signatures and operator identifiers.
- HSM attestation (sealed statement) for the HSM operator that performed the last KEK wrap (May 23 attestation).
- Confirmation that KEK chaining / chained wrapping is employed between platform KEK -> tenant KEK -> ephemeral wrapping key, plus the wrapping algorithm and cipher-suite in use.

Delivery: we can accept an encrypted tar in S3 (pre-signed) or Drive link. Transfer must be covered by our transfer NDA. We will provide a DocuSign envelope shortly.

Timeline: ideally within two weeks (by 2028-06-28). Can you confirm Redwood's ability to provide the above artifacts, the format you'll deliver, and any requests you have on our side (key IDs, ack-of-authorized-download)?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Park
Security Ops | VaultBridge
cc: Tom (compliance)

Attachments: vb_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@vaultbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 14 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: escrow snapshot + chained-wrapping audit for onboarding

Alice — thanks, we can do this. A few clarifying points so we scope correctly:

1) Snapshot contents: do you need key material (plaintext or wrapped private keys) or only the metadata/keystore manifests and wrapping headers (key IDs, wrapping algorithm, KEK fingerprint)? Our default for external requests is to provide manifests + wrapped key blobs (wrapped with Redwood-HSM key), not plaintext key material.

2) Delivery format: Redwood will produce an encrypted tar.gz (AES-256-GCM) containing: manifest.csv (metadata), rotation_log_slice.csv, and a small verification package with per-file signatures. Files will be wrapped with our HSM-backed signing key (Redwood-HSM-SIGN-2026). We can provide a pre-signed S3 PUT for you to upload or push to a restricted Drive folder. Which do you prefer?

3) Proof details: we will include an HSM attestation PDF (certified by our HSM vendor) and the signed rotation log (CSV + detached signature). Let us know if you need additional timestamps from our KMS (KMS audit export).

Action items from our side (what I'll coordinate internally):
- Marissa: generate rotation log slice and sign (CSV + .sig).
- Irene: collect HSM attestation and make sure the KEK-chaining diagram is included.
- I'll prepare a checklist and the pre-signed upload target.

Privacy/transfer: we need your signed transfer NDA before we enable upload. If you can send the DocuSign envelope link, we can treat that as the trigger. Also confirm the exact tenant ID you want included (VB-9938 or VB-9938-prod).

Estimating ~3 business days after NDA and receipt of tenant confirmation to produce the initial package.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: redwood_evidence_checklist_v1.docx (attachment stub)

From: Alice Park <alice.park@vaultbridge.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@vaultbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2028 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: escrow snapshot + chained-wrapping audit for onboarding

Thanks Rishi — we can proceed under the transfer NDA. A few answers:

- Tenant: please include VB-9938-prod (production tenant only).
- Material: wrapped key blobs + manifests + per-blob wrapping headers are sufficient (no plaintext).
- Delivery: pre-signed S3 PUT — we'll upload to the bucket you provide. Please restrict IPs to VaultBridge corporate egress if possible.
- DocuSign: envelope sent (DocuSign://envelope/0a1b2c3d) to the contact on file (security@vaultbridge.com). Please confirm when you can enable the upload after the envelope completes.

One request: can you include a short sample of your rotation_log_slice.csv with the expected column headers and one example row signed (detached .sig) so our ingestion scripts can validate? If you can put that in the Drive link preview or attach to your confirmation, that would be ideal.

Finally, we'd like to schedule a 20-minute witness call (Key ceremony walkthrough) the week of 6/20 — who from Redwood should join?

Regards,
Alice

Attachments: transfer_ndasigned_vb.pdf (stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2028 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VaultBridge evidence exchange — internal coordination

Internal plan/notes:

- Generate rotation log slice (2028-05-01 -> 2028-06-12). Format: columns = [timestamp, op_id, operator_id, key_id, op_type, wrap_algo, prev_digest, signature_kid]. Example row prep for sample delivery.
- Sign CSV with Redwood-HSM-SIGN-2026; produce detached .sig (RFC 4880-like signature header).
- Collect HSM attestation PDF (Irene to request vendor-signed attestation) and include the KEK chaining diagram (platform KEK -> tenant KEK -> ephemeral).
- Create encrypted tar: vb_escrow_snapshot_20280614.tar.enc (AES-256-GCM). Use envelope encryption: data wrapped with Redwood-KMS (arn:redwood:kms:us:backup:Redwood-EPHEM-2028); for extra assurance we will include the wrapping header showing KEK fingerprint.
- Upload: generate pre-signed S3 PUT valid 48 hours; restrict to VaultBridge IPs (announce when envelope completed).
- Schedule key-witness call: propose Tue 2028-06-20 10:00 AM PT. Attendees: Rishi, Marissa, Irene.

I'll draft the sample rotation CSV and sign it today; Rishi — will you confirm the S3 bucket name and who to add to the IP allowlist once NDA is back?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead, Compliance Evidence | Redwood Inference
